peak_capture: Reset CUDA peak counters before forward, read after adapter.validate; includes resident tensors. Model and allocator retained across ascending token lengths.
scope: Only historical matched full generation; not total device occupancy, full process startup peak, another model/modality, or partial calibration.
hardware: Publication reports RTX4090-48G; individual raw records omit device identity/capacity.

estimator.interpretation: Largest scenario in an assumed affine family F+r(R-F) with 0<=F<=A, not an empirically established bound.
estimator.lookup: Ceiling to next measured token count within50..500
estimator.kind: advisory heuristic; only B16 is measured; other batches unmeasured

plot_numeric_rounding: Plot uses the prior six-decimal GiB extract; portable CSV also retains exact source bytes.
